## New
- **Tools: install the whole arr stack.** A new *Tools* page in the side menu builds an install for Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, NZBGet, qBittorrent, Seerr, ArrHub and optionally Nginx Proxy Manager, with copy and download buttons:
  - **Docker compose** – linuxserver.io images (official ones for Seerr and ArrHub), one shared `/data` folder so Radarr/Sonarr hardlink instead of copy, PUID/PGID/TZ, ArrHub already pointed at the other apps. It can be opened straight in *Compose stacks*. A default copy is in `stack/docker-compose.yml`.
  - **Proxmox LXC** – the new `proxmox/arr-stack-lxc.sh` puts every app in its own Debian LXC container. Whiptail dialogs ask for the apps, container IDs, storage, bridge/VLAN, DHCP or consecutive static addresses, DNS and search domain, a shared media folder from the host (with a 1:1 uid/gid mapping in unprivileged containers), your own CA certificate, resources and logins. The apps are installed natively as systemd services, Radarr/Sonarr/Prowlarr/Bazarr get known API keys, qBittorrent and NZBGet get their logins, and ArrHub is set up with all of them. The page can build a copy of the script with your settings, or a one-line command for the Proxmox shell. Passwords are never written into the script.
